description: Search Scopus author profiles using native queries, or supply co-author to find an author’s collaborators. Returns one page of native Elsevier JSON, including search-results and pagination. Example: AUTHLASTNAME(Smith) AND AUTHFIRST(John). Credentials come from the server environment. Access depends on your Scopus entitlements.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for one Scopus author search page. Supply query or co-author, or both; co-author takes precedence. Offset pagination is limited to start + count <= 5000.

alias.description: Whether author-ID searches include superseding profiles. Omitted values use the API default of true.

co-author.description: One numeric Scopus author ID as a string. Returns associated co-authors and takes precedence over query.

count.description: Maximum results in this page, from 0 to 200. Defaults to 25.

field.description: Comma-separated response fields, e.g. identifier,preferred-name. Overrides view; omitted fields remain absent in the response.

query.description: Native author query, e.g. AUTHLASTNAME(Smith) AND AUTHFIRST(John). Required unless co-author is supplied; Elsevier ignores query when both are present.

reqId.description: Caller-supplied request identifier for Elsevier support.

sort.description: Up to three comma-separated sort fields; + ascending, - descending, e.g. -document-count,+surname.

start.description: Zero-based result offset. The requested window start + count must not exceed 5000; omitted count means 25.

suppressNavLinks.description: Suppress top-level navigation links. Omitted values use the API default of false.

ver.description: Resource version flags: facetexpand, subjexpand, allexpand, new; comma or semicolon separated.

view.description: Response view. STANDARD is the default and only supported view; overridden by field.

name: author_search

outputSchema.description: Unmodified JSON envelope returned by the Author Search API.

search-results.description: Native author search response, including page metadata and entries.

affiliation-url.description: Elsevier API URL for the affiliation profile.
Elsevier API URL for the affiliation profile.

affiliation-current.description: Current affiliation data in native form: one affiliation, an array of affiliations, or null.

dc:identifier.description: Scopus author identifier, including its AUTHOR_ID prefix when supplied.

document-count.description: Document count for the author, retained as the string returned by Elsevier.

eid.description: Scopus electronic identifier (EID) of the author profile.

error.description: Entry-level message returned by Elsevier, including no-result entries.

@ref.description: Relation of the linked resource, as returned by Elsevier.

link.description: Links associated with this author profile.

name-variant.description: Alternative author names reported by Elsevier.

orcid.description: ORCID identifier reported for the author.

preferred-name.description: Preferred author name, or null when supplied that way by Elsevier.

prism:url.description: Elsevier API URL for the author profile.

@frequency.description: Subject frequency reported by Elsevier, retained as a string.

subject.description: Subject area labels and frequencies reported for the author.

subject-area.description: Expanded subject-area data in its native JSON representation; its shape depends on the requested view and version flags.

entry.description: Author profiles for this page, or native entry-level messages. Fields depend on field selection and entitlements.

@ref.description: Relation of the linked resource, as returned by Elsevier.

link.description: Response and pagination links supplied by Elsevier.

@role.description: Role of the query in the OpenSearch response.

@startPage.description: Starting page reported by Elsevier, retained as a string.

opensearch:Query.description: OpenSearch metadata for the executed query.

opensearch:itemsPerPage.description: Page size reported by Elsevier, retained as a string.

opensearch:startIndex.description: Zero-based offset of this page, retained as a string.

opensearch:totalResults.description: Total matching author profiles reported by Elsevier, retained as a string.

title: Author Search
